issue_context.title: Import Semi-Automated GOGC Tuning To Avoid GC Frequently
issue_context.body:
# Enhancement

**Extensive experiments are needed to verify its feasibility.**

## Introduction

Inspired
by [How We Saved 70K Cores Across 30 Mission-Critical Services (Large-Scale, Semi-Automated Go GC Tuning @Uber)](https://eng.uber.com/how-we-saved-70k-cores-across-30-mission-critical-services/)
.

```text
 _______________  => limit: host/cgroup memory hard limit
|               |
|---------------| => gc_trigger: heap_live + heap_live * GCPercent / 100
|               |
|---------------|
|   heap_live   |
|_______________|
```

## For Golang 1.18

In Golang1.18, The garbage collector now includes non-heap sources of garbage collector work (e.g., stack scanning) when determining how frequently to run. As a result, garbage collector overhead is more predictable when these sources are significant. For most applications these changes will be negligible; however, some Go applications may now use less memory and spend more time on garbage collection, or vice versa, than before. The intended workaround is to tweak GOGC where necessary.  Semi-Automated Go GC Tuning is more important than ever.

review_comments: Is it necessary to set GOGC=0 to avoid automatic GC？
GOGC=0 will disable garbage collection. Obviously, it cannot do anything GC.
Is it by design to exit tidb if tidb can't get memTotal?
it is a design. I think if it cannot get memTotal. it will causes many tasks to be problematic.
Do we have an default value for  memTotal to avoid exit tidb?
When will this globalTuner to be nil?  if it is occur in first time to build this up? why don't we put it in startup period?
This global tuner is nil when it startup or it is diable before. When the application starts, we must use this function to init the tuner param so that it will be inited.
BTW, using ```func init()``` is not a good code style.
Move to L106 is better.
Done
So current finalizerCallback is a nil func call, later should let it call real func according our needs, right?
Yes, it is a useful library. it can do something you want during Golang Garbage Collection.
Decided enable it default?
Yes, it is to facilitate follow-up testing. we will disable it before the next release.
Should we reset the GOGC to default value when set `EnableGOGCTuner` is false?
a good suggestion. let me improve it.
Done
Do we need a interface to let user could change threshod? for example set a sysvar to change gc threshold to make gc more controlable?

Now we have a switch to control whether to enable the ```gogctuner```. But after merging this PR, we will add the HTTP API for a user to control the threshold. If it adds to this PR. This pr will be too big to be reviewed.
The variable is not concurrent-safe, right? Maybe need some comments.

add some comments.

```
// It is not thread-safe. so it is a private, singleton pattern to avoid misuse.
```
Why not have an interface called start or somethings like this?
Because when it existed. it should be in start mode. it is a cycle-refence object. it never is deleted by GC. so it need a stop function to make it be deleted.
